nameForms.name: Duchy of Austria
nameForms.note: The Habsburg Austrian line begins with Rudolf I's enfeoffment of his sons in 1282; after Ladislaus's death, the Austrian inheritance passed to Frederick III of the Leopoldian line.
nameForms.noteCn: 哈布斯堡奥地利支系始于 1282 年鲁道夫一世将奥地利分封给诸子；拉迪斯拉斯去世后，奥地利继承至利奥波德支的腓特烈三世。

holders.note: Enfeoffed his sons Albert and Rudolf with Austria in 1282.
holders.noteCn: 1282 年将奥地利分封给诸子阿尔布雷希特与鲁道夫。

holders.note: Co-ruler with his brother Albert; he renounced his Austrian share in 1283.
holders.noteCn: 与兄长阿尔布雷希特共治；1283 年放弃奥地利份额。

holders.note: Received Austria with Rudolf II and continued as sole Habsburg duke after 1283.
holders.noteCn: 与鲁道夫二世共同受封奥地利，1283 年后成为唯一哈布斯堡公爵。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Albert I; rival King of the Romans from 1314.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父阿尔布雷希特一世；1314 年起为对立的罗马人国王。

holders.note: Ruled Austria with Otto the Merry and acquired Carinthia and Carniola.
holders.noteCn: 与快乐的奥托共治奥地利，并取得克恩滕与卡尼奥拉。

holders.note: Co-ruler with Albert II the Wise until his death.
holders.noteCn: 与智者阿尔布雷希特二世共治，至其去世。

holders.note: Succeeded Albert II the Wise; known as the Founder for his institutional reforms.
holders.noteCn: 继承智者阿尔布雷希特二世；以制度建设著称，号称创建者。

holders.note: Co-ruled with Leopold III after Rudolf IV, then headed the Albertinian line after 1379.
holders.noteCn: 鲁道夫四世之后与利奥波德三世共治，1379 年后成为阿尔布雷希特支首领。

holders.note: Co-ruled with Albert III; the Treaty of Neuberg assigned him the Inner Austrian lands.
holders.noteCn: 与阿尔布雷希特三世共治；诺伊贝格条约将内奥地利领地分给他。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Albert III in the Albertinian line.
holders.noteCn: 在阿尔布雷希特支继承其父阿尔布雷希特三世。

holders.note: Albert V of Austria; later King Albert II, whose death left a posthumous heir.
holders.noteCn: 奥地利的阿尔布雷希特五世，后为国王阿尔布雷希特二世；其去世时遗腹子尚未出生。

holders.note: Posthumous son of Albert V; after his death Austria passed to Frederick III of the Leopoldian line.
holders.noteCn: 阿尔布雷希特五世的遗腹子；其去世后奥地利转至利奥波德支的腓特烈三世。

holders.note: Inherited Austria after Ladislaus's death through the Leopoldian line; later Holy Roman Emperor Frederick III.
holders.noteCn: 拉迪斯拉斯去世后经利奥波德支继承奥地利；后为神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈三世。
